description: Generate framework-aware fix alternatives for a specific accessibility issue. For color contrast issues, returns 3 alternatives (minimal, brand-aligned, high contrast); brand palette is auto-extracted from the live URL using our scanner if `brandColors` is omitted. For label/ARIA issues, returns 1-2 alternatives. Each alternative includes ready-to-paste code for the detected framework.

brandColors.description: Brand palette for brand-aligned suggestions. If omitted on a contrast issue with a `url`, auto-extracted via the scanner.

context.description: Parent element outerHTML for context (~400 chars)

html.description: The element's outerHTML — send at most ~600 chars

issue.description: Issue object from scan_page (with selector, wcag, impact, message, fix.currentValue), or a plain-text issue description

url.description: Page URL — also used to auto-extract brand palette for contrast issues if `brandColors` is not provided.

name: generate_ai_fix
title: Suggest a framework-aware fix
